nom: PEACH & LILY Hydrobubble Deep Foam Cleanser

avis.texte: I used to only use the hydrogel cleanser and I loved it and the texture/feel, I just wanted to try something that felt like a little bit of a deeper cleanse. I like it so far, it foams up really nice and leaves my pores feeling clean. My skin does feel a little tight after sometimes, but I've only been using it for about a month, it hasn't noticeably cause any breakouts or redness which is a big plus for me since I have very sensitive combo skin.

avis.titre: I love this product and will continue to use!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product. Such a great product for someone with sensitive skin.

avis.titre: Great for deep clean face wash in the shower
avis.texte: This face was is super foamy and bubbly like the name says. I like it use it in the shower rather than at the sink, and my skin ends up feeling deeply cleansed afterward. I have really sensitive skin and this doesn't bother my skin at all.
This is my go to product for my daily routine. Leaves my skin soft and ready for the remaining products to give me that glossy look
A little goes a long way. But for the price im not sure its worth it.It also kinda smells like cemicals.

avis.titre: It's ok, but don't use all the time
avis.texte: I recently tried this out.I would recommend only using this once a day or every couple of days.Smelled ok.It is exspensive,but a little goes a long way.So it lasts long.combination skin approved.Good for acne.
Very clean product and cruelty free. I love how clean and fresh my face feels!

avis.titre: Cleanses without drying out my skin
avis.texte: This cleanser works very well on my oily T-zone. I have to work hard to avoid acne breakouts because my skin scars so easily, but an oily T-zone means I can't use a cleanser for sensitive skin. This one is perfect.
My favorite cleanser from peach and lily!! It lathers really well and my face feels so clean after each use!

My favorite P&L cleanser and this is coming from someone who has used the gel cleanser long before this one. I'm on my second one and I have my boyfriend using it too! He used to have cystic acne and nodules when we first got together 8 years ago. Took about 4 years to figure out a routine that works without a prescription or dermatologist treatment. This product has not caused any flare ups since he started using it. Oh & I'm begging for a travel size PLEASE!!

avis.titre: Review on Hydrobubble Deep Foam Cleanser
avis.texte: Beautiful cleanser. Thoroughly cleanses the skin, no over-stripping. Perfect cleanser.
This wash is super bubble and everytime I use it my face feels so clean. I use it morning and night with no issues
This stuff feels so good on my face. I feel like it really cleans and gets deep into my skin!

Unfortunately I found this was too stripping of oils, that it would cause breakouts everytime. I have used almost all peach and lily products, and this was the least likely one I would recommend. I would say as far as foam cleansers, it has the best foam, and smell. Using it up as body wash instead. Hoping if you decide to buy iy, that you try a sample first.
Leaves me feeling clean without feeling dry, great for use in a full routine

I have combination like skin that is not sensative. I was shocked and let down when this product caused me acneic breakouts. Being someone who does not struggle with acne, this product has caused major breakouts rhat lasted 3 weeks. I now switched the product over.
This is a great cleanser. It doesn't take much of the product to get the good results. Worth the cost.
I'm impressed with this cleanser. My skin feels like it's clean without being stripped of oils. It's nice and hydrating. Will be repurchasing.
Great every day face wash. Moisturizing but leaves your skin feeling very clean.
I was looking for a new cleanser and this one is it. It leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without stripping it.

I wanted to like this as the Ulta employee recommended it and talked really highly of it. However, this has made my skin extremely dry. I've been using this since May and I feel like my skin has gotten worse. I can't even imagine using this more than once a day.
This cleanser is light but also keeps me from breaking out. It cleanses well without drying me out and adds brightness to my skin. I have sensitive skin and this is my go-to!
I switched from the Glass cleanser to this one, and I noticed my skin is not as dry. A little bit goes a long way.

My skin is oily but dry at the same time if that makes sense at all. I tried out a handful of diff facewashes that would either make me break out or would cause my makeup to spread. This one has now been my go to. Love it.
I love this face wash! It washes the makeup off so gently but so well! This is a must have in my skin care routine everyday!

I tried this face wash as recommended by an employee at ULTA when I asked for something that would help with breakouts because they were out of my usual. I have oily skin that has been breaking out a lot recently. I liked the way my skin felt after washing it but I didn't see any results. My breakouts continued to get worse. I used the entire bottle because I wanted to give it a chance. I noticed after finishing the bottle that the pores on my nose were DISGUSTING. I've never had an issue with that before and this face wash is supposed to be deep cleaning. All that being said, this is not all it's made out to be and is not worth the price.

I love the way this feels on my face; it provides such a great deep clean without drying my face. It also does a fantastic job removing makeup. I really wish it came in a travel size, I would love to be able to toss it in my carry on

avis.titre: A Moisturizing and Gentle Deep Clean!
avis.texte: I bought this because I was looking for a good deep cleaning face wash that was still gentle and moisturizing; I was impressed! I use a small amount for my entire face and it foams up so well! It is a deep clean feeling that leaves the skin hydrated!
This is a great cleanser after using the Ginger Oil Melt Cleanser to remove my make-up at the end of the day. My face feels SOOOO clean!

this cleanser is the BEST. when used after an oil cleanser for double cleansing it removes any left over makeup really really well. you dont need a lot as it lathers very nicely. it makes my face feel so fresh and clean.
I've been looking for a deep cleaning cleanser that doesn't dry my skin out and the ingredients in this look great!
Love this cleanser. Has a good lather and leave my skin feeling fresh and clean. As someone with sensitive skin I appreciate trying a new product without having backlash from my skin.
A little bit goes a long way. Great lather, not at all drying

The first time I used this product I was actually REALLY surprised. My face felt clean and refreshed. It also took more of my eye makeup off (mascara and light eyeliner) without me having to do my normal routine. I've only been using for a month and so far I can say I like it.

avis.titre: Ive tried most of peach a
avis.texte: Ive tried most of peach and lily cleansers and this one has the best lather in my opinion! As someone who washes my face multiple times because i have oily skin and tend to feel really heavy and clogged by the end of the day, this cleanser is so bubbly and refreshing + a little goes a long way! This one might be my favorite.
This is so bubbly and refreshing--leaving super cleansed skin! I am not one to return to a product, but I will with this and many other products from Peach and Lily. Also YUKA approved :)
Love this! I alternate daily with an acne wash when showering and this is helping to keep my skin hydrated and protects my skin barrier. Just reordered!
Great foam cleanser. I've tried the gel cleanser which I liked a lot but found the foam cleanser to be just as great! It lathers good and you only need a small amount.

It leaves your face clean, it smells amazing. With having eczema is very soothing and calming to the skin. I was introduced to it at Ulta one day when I was having inflammation at the time, but this is very soft on the skin. I now have a routine that implements more products from peach lily so in about a month or two I'll see a huge difference, but I'm seeing a difference now with week four

I am a Korean skincare lover and one of my favorite parts is how clean my skin is after the cleansing. I put this as step 2 (step 1 - DHC deep cleansing oil; step 2: Peach and Lily facial polish(powder form)), and my skin feels super clean, prepped and ready to absorb the actives from the rest of my routine. Great part of a glass skin routine!
My face feels smooth and nice after using! Would definitely buy again!
It cleans well, but haven't seen any noticeable improvements with pores. It may take a little longer for results visibility.
Nice foam leaving a deep clean feel & not too harsh for my sensitive skin. Small amount goes a long way
My face feels soft and not stripped of moisture. Has a really subtle smell doesn't have any perfumes. I think my pores look smaller too!
It was a good face wash a little goes along it kinda smelled like flowers it helped my skin get more clear
I love the sudsy feel of this cleaner. I tried the ginger melt and it never felt like it was cleaning my face properly. This feels great on my skin!
This is such a gentle cleanser and it cleans out my pores really well! I'm so happy this product was made because it will always be part of my cleansing routine!
It's sparkling, has excellent ingredients, and leaves your face feeling fresh. I recommend this product.
This cleanser is really good, the foam is rich, creamy and soft. My skin feels fresh and clean but not dry or tight at all, even when it's irritated. A little goes a long way !

So I will say I love the power calm cleanser but wasnt a fan of the fact that it didnt bubble and stayed pretty flat. I decided to go out on a whim and try this hydrobubble cleanser…. Oh my goodness! The bubbles! It makes my skin feel so soft afterwards too!

This cleanser is great! I use it first thing in the morning in the shower. It gets the oil and grime from the night time off when and cleanses leaving your skin feeling very refreshed and ready for makeup. With only using one product! It's amazing. Highly recommend.

I started trying this to have a comparison with the gel cleanser and I love this one much more. The consistency of the product is easier to control when dispensing it from the tube and you don't need a lot to get the suds effect. It's very gentle on my skin and has zero fragrance (which I also love). A little goes a long way so I'm confident the product will last me longer than the gel cleanser used to.
Perfect balance between foaming clean and not feeling stripped. Does great solo or as second step of double cleanse. Will reorder!
My favorite P&L cleanser! Foaming, effective, and not stripping.
Loved this cleanser! Only need a small amount and it foams up a lot. My face felt clean and didnt feel stripped of moisture.

Had been using a quality, but lower price point, cleanser, and noticed blackheads returning on my nose. Was sad but moved on and forgot about them bc I didn't want to spend money on another product. Got a sample of this and used it once daily for a few days, then randomly noticed that they were ALL GONE. This product is a miracle.
I love it, very gentle cleanser and I like how it rates for its ingredients. My skin is sensitive and I haven't had any issues.

I was using Origins Checks & Balances cleanser but I noticed it was making my skin very dry. I use Peach & Lily's moisturizer and an Ulta employee suggested I try their new cleanser. No more dry skin! It has tons of lather with just a tiny bit! YAY!
Hydrates and refreshes skin, does a nice job cleaning makeup away.

I've been using this product after the Ginger Melt daily for a week. I'm 61 and tend towards dry skin. My skin looks so clear! I was worried this product would be too drying, but it's not. I will definitely buy this again!
I love the face wash, my first time trying and will be using!!
I have been using this cleanser for a while now and like the soft feeling that your skin has after cleansing.

I thought the Power Calm Hydrating Cleanser was not effective enough at cleaning my face, so I bought this product. I do feel this one penetrates my pores more and gets more dirt off my skin. I have since reverted back to using the OG cleanser more and following up with the Peach Slices acne exfoliating toner, but this is still a good option for deeper cleansing.

I love this cleanser! It's by far my favorite cleanser from Peach and Lily! It has a mild smell and it makes my skin feel soft and fresh. My face always feels so clean without feeling dry and I've noticed a brightening to my skin!
I love the face wash. The deep cleanse is great. Same as the other. My wife finds the deep cleanse to be too harsh. I think it's nice as part of routine a few times a week.
It makes my skin so soft, and it adds a nice glow I would totally buy it again.

This has become a staple in my routine. I love the way this cleanser foams up, while still being gentle. It makes my face feel nice and clean without being overly drying. Will repurchase once I'm out!
I wear a lot of makeup and this cleanser is so thorough yet gentle which is extremely rare for a foaming wash!

avis.titre: Gentle cleanser and enjoyable to use.
avis.texte: I normally use an oil-based cleanser but recently purchased the Hydrobubble Deep Foam Cleanser for my son. I decided to use it on a whim and was not sure if I'd like the foaming effect (other foaming cleansers in the past have felt like they stripped too much oil from my skin and left me dry), but the Hydrobubble Deep Foam Cleanser is very gentle and doesn't excessively bubble or foam. It makes my skin feel very soft and clean after use, and is very easy to wash away. A small amount goes a long way, so I feel like it's also a great deal for the price.
Love this cleanser. It cleans and hydrates without stripping the skin which has helped so much this winter.
This cleaner is light and airy and leaves my skin feeling clean.
A little goes a long way. You just need a little for it to foam up. So far it's great.
My eyes were too sensitive for this wash. Went back to the gel which is A+
I love the bubbly feel to it and its definitiely doing its job.
I love the bubbly feel to it and its definitiely doing its job.
I really enjoy using this foam cleanser. It feels really good on my skin and cleans my face nicely. I would definitely buy this again.

I thought the gel cleanser couldn't be beat but was curious how the foam cleanser would work. So glad I did! I LOVE IT! I use the gel cleanser in the morning & the foam cleanser at night. Perfect regimen! I was having the perimenopause breakouts on my face. Since I switched to Peach & Lily for my entire regimen, no breakouts at all.
I would recommend if you are hust starting your skin care routine! But for me i felt it lacks that deep cleansing punch, i have tried a couple of times and havent noticed a difference.

This is my favorite cleanser I've gotten from Peach and Lily. It is light, not too fragranced and the lather is impeccable. I've come across too many "foaming" cleansers that just don't foam and you end up using way more than you should. With the Hydrobubble Deep Foam cleanser I can get away with a pea-sized amount for my entire face. I'm very impressed.

I have been a loyal user of Peach and Lily Gentle Cleanser so when this came out, I know I have to have it! I love that it's very foamy, a little goes a long way. Both cleanser never gave me that dry feeling after washing my face. This one feels it will last longer when it comes to quantity. But both cleanser are my favorite!!😍
This cleanser leaves skin feeling so clean without over drying!
This face wash has been great so far. I have oily, dry, acne skin and this product hasn't dried my face out. I'm already seeing a difference in hoe my skins looks and feels.

The cleanser is great but it is very foamy. Depending on your skin type you might prefer the power calm cleanser as I do myself. Again this is great if you prefer something more foamy that does not strip your face at the same time.

I love peach and lily. Their calming gel cleanser was the first cleanser i fell in love with and showed me that your cleanser matters. Over time i found i preferred a foaming cleanser after oil cleansing - their ginger melt oil cleanser is also my favorite. The second they came out with a foaming cleanser i bought it without hesitation. I will say that its not the most hydrating cleanser i own so i sometimes put a pump of a super hydrating cleanser in wirh it a thats perfect. Thats why it only got 4 and not a perfect score. Still waiting on a main stream super hydrating foaming cleanser. But i follow up cleansing (which i only do at night) with hydration city so not too bad for me personally.

avis.titre: So many good things about it
avis.texte: This thoughtfully formulated, uniquely textured face wash is my go-to when I need a really thorough cleansing. I really enjoy how much it lathers up, the great ingredients, the fact that it does NOT leave my face feeling squeaky dry but nourished, the good packaging, and how a little goes a long way. That being said, I really was hoping for it to be lightly fragranced like the Power Calm - it does have a fresh scent but I wouldn't call it a fragrance. Power Calm leaves my skin too dry, so this is my new deep cleanser, but aromatherapy is one of the big reasons that I do skincare and I just can't get past it - hence 4 (and a half, really) stars instead of a resounding 5! ALSO do not accidentally get this facewash up your nose like I did (or I assume in your eyes either), as it does sting a little. Please try this if you're looking for a great deep foaming cleanser!
I LOVE this deep foaming cleanser. I paired this with the oil cleanser and my face has never looked so good. I have a new confidence for my skin. The shipping was fast and easy!
Love this cleanser. My skin feels very clean and refreshed after use. One of my go to face washes at the moment !
This is my favorite peach and lily cleanser!! Leaves skin feeling refreshing. ;) #bubblez #efficient #removesoild&dirt
My favorite cleansing texture!! Smooth and soft to the touch foam. I prefer this over the P&L gel cleanser. I still pair this with their oil cleanser and they go well together as expected!!

My combination skin can be tricky and some products are too harsh and cause stripping/drying. Thankfully this cleanser leaves my skin feeling clean and soft. Sometimes I mix it on top of the Rice Dough Smoothing Facial Scrub and I get a really gentle, deep clean which leaves my skin looking fresh with smaller pores.
Product is excellent as is the entire P&L line, faithful user for years!
This stuff is amazing. It has a cushion feel to it, cleans thoroughly without over drying.

The other gentle cleanser was good but I feel better about this one. Not only is it way thicker, I believe it leaves my skin feeling cleaner than the previous cleanser. I'm happy to have made the switch.
Just okay. It was actually drying instead of hydrating. Prefer the power calm cleanser over this one.
I love it so far. My face very clean after using it! Love how it suds. 10/10
This is my new favorite cleanser. If feels so nice on the face and leaves my face feeling clean. Its a nice gentle clean without being abrasive.

I love this cleanser, it makes my skin feel so clean and fresh without drying it out! I have been using it day and night and already notice that my skin is feeling and looking so much better! Thank you Peach and Lily!
My skin feels so soft and smell so so good. And it didn't took long to arrive. I will recommend this product to everyone.

I really like this Foam Cleanser. Feels refreshing and love the spa like smell. Since I'm older, I have to make sure it doesn't dry out my skin and this doesn't. My skin feels soft and moisturized when I'm done. A little goes a long way and will continue to purchase.
Love this cleanser. Deep cleans my skin without leaving any residue or dry feeling after.
Super gentle cleanser. Bubbles well. Do not need much. Works great for my sensitive, acne prone skin.
Im a huge fan of other peach & lily products but this one just didn't do it for me! This face wash is super drying. Immediately after rinsing it off, my skin starts to feel incredibly dry and flakey.
This helps get extra grime, sunscreen, makeup or sweat off my skin. It's still gentle though to not dry out. I use it in between the gel wash.

It feels great on my face, so soft and smooth! It leaves my skin feeling soft and hydrated. It doesn't strip my skin of moisture. It's also fragrance free. A little goes a long way! I love foam cleansers and am super glad that P&L have made one of their own. :blush:
Skin feels really clean after using this, but not dried out. Good for sensitive skin.
Good cleanser. This does not leave my skin feeling dry or stripped. My skin feels clean but healthy.
This new cleanser made my face feel so plump and smooth. I'll sometimes add some of the daily exfoliant in the mix to scrub my skin from the dead skin cell and it makes it feel so soft. 11/10!!
I have sensitive skin and this has been a lifesaver for my face.
